$comment: Check Control (CC-ID) messages: the dash warnings with the triangle. Written in Klemme15's own words from community lists (sources per entry). 'high' = the ID and meaning agree across community lists and a local cross-check of BMW's cluster text table; 'medium' = community lists only. BMW's own texts are never included; when the user has their BMW files, Klemme15 shows BMW's wording next to these. Severity follows the triangle colour: Critical = red (stop safely), Warning and Advisory = yellow. IDs are for E8x/E9x/E6x/E7x clusters; other models can differ.

messages.title: Steering fault
messages.description: The steering system (active steering or power assistance) has reported a problem. Steering may feel heavier or different.
messages.hint: Drive carefully and have the steering module's fault memory read.

messages.title: Door open (front right)
messages.description: The cluster sees a door open. The exact door per ID comes from community lists.
messages.hint: If every door is shut, check the door's latch switch.

messages.title: Door open (front left)
messages.description: The cluster sees a door open. The exact door per ID comes from community lists.
messages.hint: If every door is shut, check the door's latch switch.

messages.title: Door open (rear left)
messages.description: The cluster sees a door open. The exact door per ID comes from community lists.
messages.hint: If every door is shut, check the door's latch switch.

messages.title: Door open (rear right)
messages.description: The cluster sees a door open. The exact door per ID comes from community lists.
messages.hint: If every door is shut, check the door's latch switch.

messages.title: Bonnet open
messages.description: The bonnet (hood) is reported as not latched.
messages.hint: If it is closed, the bonnet contact switch is a common cause.

messages.title: Boot open
messages.description: The boot (trunk) lid is reported as open.
messages.hint: If it is closed, check the boot lock's switch.

messages.title: Dynamic Brake Control failed
messages.description: The brake-assist function is off. Normal braking still works.
messages.hint: Drive moderately and have the DSC module read.

messages.title: Engine oil at minimum
messages.description: The oil level sensor reads the minimum mark.
messages.hint: Top up with the correct oil soon; check for leaks or oil use.

messages.title: Engine oil below minimum
messages.description: The oil level is below the minimum mark. Running low on oil can damage the engine.
messages.hint: Top up before driving further.

messages.title: Engine fault, reduced power
messages.description: The engine ECU has limited power because of a fault.
messages.hint: Read the engine (DME/DDE) fault memory; a matching fault code will be there.

messages.title: Engine fault, stop carefully
messages.description: A serious engine fault. The car asks you to stop when it is safe.
messages.hint: Stop safely and read the engine fault memory before driving on.

messages.title: Increased emissions
messages.description: An emissions-related fault is stored (the US 'check engine' light usually comes on too).
messages.hint: Read the engine fault memory; misfires, lambda and VANOS faults are common causes.

messages.title: Fuel cap not closed
messages.description: The fuel filler cap was reported as loose or missing.
messages.hint: Tighten the cap until it clicks; the message clears after some driving.

messages.title: Engine fault, drive moderately
messages.description: The engine ECU has found a fault and asks for gentle driving.
messages.hint: Read the engine fault memory.

messages.title: DSC failed
messages.description: Stability control is not working. The car brakes normally but without DSC help.
messages.hint: Read the DSC module; wheel speed sensors and the steering angle sensor are common causes.

messages.title: DSC switched off
messages.description: Stability control has been switched off with the button.
messages.hint: Press the DSC button to turn it back on.

messages.title: Engine overheated, stop carefully
messages.description: The engine temperature is too high. Driving on can damage the engine.
messages.hint: Stop safely, let it cool, and check coolant level, water pump and thermostat.

messages.title: Service due
messages.description: A scheduled service item (oil, brakes, inspection) is due.
messages.hint: See the service list in the iDrive / cluster menu; reset it after the work is done.

messages.title: Fasten seat belt
messages.description: A seat belt is not fastened.

messages.title: Particulate filter fault
messages.description: The diesel particulate filter has reported a problem.
messages.hint: Read the DDE fault memory.

messages.title: Flat tyre monitor failed
messages.description: The flat tyre warning (RPA) or tyre pressure monitor isn't working, so a puncture may not be shown.
messages.hint: Check the tyre pressures by hand, then re-initialise the system.

messages.title: Flat tyre
messages.description: A tyre is losing pressure.
messages.hint: Stop safely and check the tyres. Run-flat tyres allow limited driving at reduced speed.

messages.title: Charge the key
messages.description: The rechargeable battery in the key (comfort access / some keys) is low.
messages.hint: Leave the key in the ignition slot while driving to charge it.

messages.title: Key battery low
messages.description: The battery in the remote key is weak. The car still starts with the key in the slot.
messages.hint: Many E-series keys have a rechargeable cell that charges while the key sits in the ignition slot, so a longer drive often clears it. If it keeps coming back, the cell is worn out: replace the cell (check which type your key uses) or the key.

messages.title: Key battery low (standby functions)
messages.description: The key's battery is too weak for remote functions such as auxiliary heating.
messages.hint: Replace or charge the key's battery.

messages.title: Servotronic failed
messages.description: The speed-dependent power steering assistance isn't working. Steering may be heavier.
messages.hint: Have the steering fault memory read.

messages.title: Replace brake pads
messages.description: A brake pad wear sensor has been worn through.
messages.hint: Replace the pads and the wear sensor, then reset the brake service in the cluster.

messages.title: Brake fluid low, stop carefully
messages.description: The brake fluid level is low. This can mean a leak or very worn pads.
messages.hint: Stop safely and check the fluid level and for leaks before driving on.

messages.title: Trailer electrics failed
messages.description: The trailer module reports a fault (lights or wiring on the trailer side).
messages.hint: Check the trailer plug and bulbs.

messages.title: Low outside temperature
messages.description: Outside temperature is near freezing; roads may be icy.

messages.title: Left low beam out
messages.description: The left dipped-beam headlight bulb or its circuit has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb; on xenon cars check the igniter and ballast.

messages.title: Right low beam out
messages.description: The right dipped-beam headlight bulb or its circuit has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb; on xenon cars check the igniter and ballast.

messages.title: Left number plate light out
messages.description: A number plate (licence plate) light has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb; an LED plate light without a load resistor can also cause this.

messages.title: Parking lights on
messages.description: The parking (side) lights were left on with the car off.

messages.title: Left rear fog light out
messages.description: The rear fog light bulb or circuit on the left has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Left rear indicator out
messages.description: A turn signal bulb or circuit has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Right front indicator out
messages.description: A turn signal bulb or circuit has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Left low beam out
messages.description: The left dipped-beam headlight bulb or its circuit has failed (alternative ID on some clusters).
messages.hint: Replace the bulb; on xenon cars check the igniter and ballast.

messages.title: Right low beam out
messages.description: The right dipped-beam headlight bulb or its circuit has failed (alternative ID on some clusters).
messages.hint: Replace the bulb; on xenon cars check the igniter and ballast.

messages.title: Right rear fog light out
messages.description: The rear fog light bulb or circuit on the right has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Right front parking light out
messages.description: The right front side light / angel eye has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Right brake light out
messages.description: A brake light has failed. Other drivers may not see you braking.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb soon.

messages.title: Centre brake light out
messages.description: The third (centre) brake light has failed.
messages.hint: Check the LED strip and its plug.

messages.title: Left brake light out
messages.description: A brake light has failed. Other drivers may not see you braking.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb soon.

messages.title: Right number plate light out
messages.description: A number plate (licence plate) light has failed.
messages.hint: Replace the bulb.

messages.title: Flat tyre (front left)
messages.description: The front left tyre is losing pressure.
messages.hint: Stop safely and check the tyre.

messages.title: Check tyre pressures
messages.description: A tyre pressure is lower than it should be.
messages.hint: Check and correct all four pressures, then reset the tyre monitor.

messages.title: Flat tyre (front right)
messages.description: The front right tyre is losing pressure.
messages.hint: Stop safely and check the tyre.

messages.title: Flat tyre
messages.description: A tyre is losing pressure.
messages.hint: Stop safely and check the tyres.

messages.title: Washer fluid low
messages.description: The windscreen washer reservoir is low.
messages.hint: Top up washer fluid.

messages.title: Coolant level low
messages.description: The coolant expansion tank level is low.
messages.hint: Top up with the right coolant when the engine is cold and look for leaks.

messages.title: Transmission fault, drive moderately
messages.description: The gearbox control unit has found a fault and may limit gears.
messages.hint: Read the transmission (EGS) fault memory.

messages.title: Oil level sensor fault
messages.description: The engine oil level sensor isn't giving a reading, so oil level can't be shown.
messages.hint: Check the oil on the dipstick (if fitted) or have the sensor checked.

messages.title: Oil pressure low, stop carefully
messages.description: Engine oil pressure is too low. Driving on can destroy the engine.
messages.hint: Stop the engine as soon as it is safe and check the oil level.

messages.title: Alternator fault
messages.description: The alternator isn't charging. The battery will run down while you drive.
messages.hint: Drive straight to a garage with as few electrical loads as possible.

messages.title: Fuel pump fault, drive moderately
messages.description: The fuel pump control has reported a problem.
messages.hint: Read the fuel pump module (EKPS) and engine fault memories.

messages.title: Charge the battery
messages.description: The battery charge is low, for example after short trips or long standing.
messages.hint: Charge the battery with a charger; if it keeps happening, test the battery and look for a drain.

messages.title: Battery flat, emergency charging
messages.description: The battery is so low that the car has switched to emergency charging and may turn off comfort features.
messages.hint: Charge the battery and test it.

messages.title: Engine running hot, drive moderately
messages.description: Engine temperature is higher than normal.
messages.hint: Check coolant level, the electric water pump and thermostat.

messages.title: Fuel low
messages.description: The fuel level has reached reserve.
messages.hint: Refuel soon.
